summary: Large Summit car park at Mount Coot-tha, bush behind, no homes nearby.
reasons: Open asphalt car park, bush around
Plenty of room off the road

best_section.where: Western end of the Summit car park, near the restaurant side

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by bush and the restaurant; no homes within sight.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park off the Summit road, many bays, vans can pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Visitor traffic by day to the restaurant and lookout; road noise is distant.
drivers.convention: Many cars parked in the QLD image; one sign here is for motorcycle bays only.

flags: Tourist car park, likely busy until closing
Perimeter grade reads steep (22% max), but bays look level
sun_shade: Mostly open asphalt; tree shade along the west and north edges, so morning shade on the west side.
cannot_judge: Overnight rules or gate closing times
